paragraphs: Friend, here's what I love about this one. Before a single sword is lifted, the LORD says, "Do not be afraid or discouraged," and then, "See, I have delivered into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land." (Joshua 8:1) The win was settled before the first step. This is the same Israel that fled from Ai last time (Joshua 7:4), and God still hands them the victory.

Now look at HOW it's given. God doesn't just say "it's yours" and send them home to nap. He gives Joshua a plan, an ambush behind the city (Joshua 8:2), and Joshua follows it down to the last detail. Then the LORD says, "Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city," and Joshua does exactly that (Joshua 8:18). Friend, God's promise and our obedience aren't rivals. They walk together, and that's the whole recipe.

This also shows that a failure isn't the end of the road. Israel lost at Ai, dealt with the sin that cost them (Joshua 7:26), and God spoke to them again. Israel also took only the cattle and plunder, "as the LORD had commanded Joshua" (Joshua 8:27), so they listened and followed His word this time. So if you've ever stumbled, I've been to the back of a drawer, and I'm telling you the LORD still has work for you. Listen to Him, do what He says, and trust that He keeps His word. And this story isn't over, because there's more of Israel's journey still to come.
